notes.title: House of Moiré - Now Available
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the official release of House of Moiré! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42749509/ed581d95a7472017bab1236d4651e1bdd1aa2449.jpg

An escapist, meditative and abstract atmospheric experience where the user can explore a world outside of our present reality.

This unique XR artwork is conceived by artists Chloe Alexandra Thompson and Matthew Edwards (aesthetic.stalemate), and developed by the international festival MUTEK.

[previewyoutube=pPHDhQcg-mU;full][/previewyoutube]

After being showcased in various exhibitions around the world, at film festivals, music festivals, and digital creativity events, it's now your turn to experience it!

Share your feedback by leaving a review on the page! And feel free to reach out to us if you encounter any issues or have any questions.


– The MUTEK Team

notes.title: HOUSE OF MOIRÉ OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE: June 30
notes.content:
We're back, and after months of waiting, we're ready to open the doors to House of Moiré!

Click on the link below for a preview:

[previewyoutube=SVVlnE5VhA4;full][/previewyoutube]

House of Moiré takes us into a surreal house with multiple rooms, all unique and enigmatic. Can you unravel the sonic and visual mysteries behind each one?

Observe and listen to the whispers emanating from the walls, floors and ceilings. Let yourself be drawn in by the optical patterns. Immerse yourself this shapeshifting world, constantly in motion. 


Join us at House of Moiré on Friday June 30 at 9:00AM PST for the official release!

notes.title: Trip before the launch
notes.content:
The second release from our Immersive Collection, House of Moiré is a Virtual Reality trip into a surreal and psychic realm, where sound objects and moving architecture pave and play your way forward.

We look forward to sharing this experience with you!

[previewyoutube=lOw_yWT6ClU;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring responsive audiovisual programming and shapeshifting architecture, House of Moiré is a non-game artwork playing with the rules of physics and optical art. Along this curious path, will you discern real from illusory?

Add House of Moiré to your wishlist, be among the first to unravel the mysteries of its design! 

Want to learn more?
House of Moiré is based on a live performance by interdisciplinary artists and collaborators Chloe Alexandra Thompson and Matthew Edwards. Chloe is a composer and sound designer interested in the physicality of sound and mediation of technology in installation and performance, and Matthew blends installation art, performance and virtual reality.

notes.title: First prototype viewing
notes.content:
These three VR artworks come straight the Festival world. So with MUTEK Festival launching soon, our pre-event conference was the occasion for a few community members to exclusively test out the works, and for the developers and artists to see public reactions for the first time.

Next public showcases from August 23 to 26 during MUTEK Montreal
More info

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42741267/016fc50e38be11ef0c08ee358e302eeb96f68c67.jpg


After this first public test, several fixes are to come:

Audio

 Adjustment of the audio fades
 Finetuning low frequencies
 Finetuning sound levels and spatialization


Visual

 Polishing visual objects
 Sequencing of scenes
 Correction of display defects and resolution problems


Environment

 Audio tracking
 Video tracking
 Motion detection


Other

 Adjustment of the sound level to fit a busy space (optimized for public demonstrations for galleries and/or festivals)
